description:
Get aggregates computed only from fully resolved books: forecast counts, returns and hit rates, and how many
    books beat, matched (flat) or trailed SPY, each book's verdict graded on its cap-weighted long picks. The hit
    rates count the books graded under the published rule, from published_rule_from on; the 69 backtest books before
    it follow a rule of their own and are reported apart in the backtest_ fields, verdicts included. Use this for
    overall performance, get_calibration to test the ranking itself, and get_book_portfolio for a single book.
name: get_track_record_stats
title: Headline stats
